Machine Learning Engineer (Applied LLMs)
Canva, Sydney

The role
You will help ship LLM-powered features to millions of users, working between research and product engineering.

Responsibilities
- Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and evaluation harnesses
- Fine-tune and serve open-weight models; optimise inference latency and cost
- Write production Python services and data pipelines
- Partner with product engineers to integrate models into user-facing features

Requirements
- Strong Python; experience with PyTorch and embeddings
- Hands-on experience with LLM integration, prompt design and evaluation
- Familiarity with vector databases (Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector)
- Experience deploying services on AWS or GCP
- Degree in Computer Science or related field
